title: Late Payment Finance Charges and the Supported Credit Limit (Commercial Credit Account)
content:
The late payment finance charges on a Commercial Credit Account set a percentage that multiplies **the supported limit**.

### Clause

The supported limit is reduced to seventy percent for an account charged three or more late payment finance charges dated less than twelve whole months before today, to eighty-five percent for an account charged one or two such charges, and kept whole for an account charged none.

Whole months between a date and today are the difference in calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month, with no move of a month-end date to a shorter month's last day.

### Schedule

| Finance charges dated less than 12 whole months before today | Supported limit kept |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 70 percent |
| 1 or 2 | 85 percent |
| none | 100 percent |

*Hypothetical:* a supported limit of 40000.00 on an account with two such charges is 34000.00; with three, 28000.00.
